python - <<'PY'
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json','r') as f:
    data=json.load(f)

# Data prep
cat_totals = data['global_category_totals']['data']
income = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']
top = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']

# Consistent category colors (editorial, colorblind-conscious)
colors = {
    'Communicable':'#1f77b4',  # blue
    'NCD':'#d62728',           # red
    'Injury':'#7f7f7f'         # gray
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family':'DejaVu Sans',
    'axes.titlesize':12,
    'axes.labelsize':10,
    'xtick.labelsize':9,
    'ytick.labelsize':9,
    'legend.fontsize':9
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16,10), dpi=200)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1,1.1], width_ratios=[1,1], hspace=0.28, wspace=0.2)

# Panel A: Structural transition (global totals)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
years=[1990,2024]
x=np.arange(len(years))
width=0.22
for i,cat in enumerate(['Communicable','NCD','Injury']):
    vals=[next(d['dalys_millions'] for d in cat_totals if d['year']==y and d['category']==cat) for y in years]
    ax1.bar(x+(i-1)*width, vals, width=width, color=colors[cat], label=cat)
    for xi,v in zip(x+(i-1)*width, vals):
        ax1.text(xi, v+20, f'{v:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years])
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)')
ax1.set_xlabel('Year')
ax1.set_title('Global DALY Burden Shift: Communicable to NCD Dominance')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, linestyle='--')
ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

# Panel B: Income-group composition (100% stacked bars by year)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
income_order=['Low income','Lower-middle income','Upper-middle income','High income']
bar_w=0.34
x2=np.arange(len(income_order))

for j,year in enumerate([1990,2024]):
    rows=[r for r in income if r['year']==year]
    rows=sorted(rows, key=lambda r: income_order.index(r['income_group']))
    c=np.array([r['communicable_pct'] for r in rows])
    n=np.array([r['ncd_pct'] for r in rows])
    inj=np.array([r['injury_pct'] for r in rows])
    xpos=x2 + (-bar_w/2 if year==1990 else bar_w/2)
    ax2.bar(xpos, c, width=bar_w, color=colors['Communicable'])
    ax2.bar(xpos, n, width=bar_w, bottom=c, color=colors['NCD'])
    ax2.bar(xpos, inj, width=bar_w, bottom=c+n, color=colors['Injury'])
    for xi,cv,nv in zip(xpos,c,n):
        ax2.text(xi, cv/2, f'{cv:.0f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color='white', weight='bold')
        ax2.text(xi, cv+nv/2, f'{nv:.0f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color='white', weight='bold')

ax2.set_ylim(0,100)
ax2.set_yticks(np.arange(0,101,20))
ax2.set_xticks(x2)
ax2.set_xticklabels(income_order, rotation=15, ha='right')
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of total DALYs (%)')
ax2.set_xlabel('World Bank income group')
ax2.set_title('Disease-Burden Composition by Income Group (1990 vs 2024)')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, linestyle='--')
ax2.set_axisbelow(True)

# Year key for panel B
ax2.text(0.01,1.03,'Left bar = 1990   Right bar = 2024', transform=ax2.transAxes, fontsize=9)

# Panel C: Top 10 rank change slope chart
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
rows90=sorted([r for r in top if r['year']==1990], key=lambda r:r['rank'])
rows24=sorted([r for r in top if r['year']==2024], key=lambda r:r['rank'])

r90={r['cause']:r for r in rows90}
r24={r['cause']:r for r in rows24}
all_causes=sorted(set(r90)|set(r24))

x_left=0
x_right=1
for cause in all_causes:
    y0=r90[cause]['rank'] if cause in r90 else 11
    y1=r24[cause]['rank'] if cause in r24 else 11
    cat=(r24[cause]['category'] if cause in r24 else r90[cause]['category'])
    lw=2.6 if (y0<=10 and y1<=10 and abs(y1-y0)>=3) else 1.6
    alpha=0.95 if (y0<=10 and y1<=10) else 0.35
    ax3.plot([x_left,x_right],[y0,y1], color=colors[cat], lw=lw, alpha=alpha)

# Labels for each side
for r in rows90:
    ax3.text(x_left-0.02, r['rank'], f"{r['rank']}. {r['cause']} ({r['dalys_millions']:.1f})",
             ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8)
for r in rows24:
    ax3.text(x_right+0.02, r['rank'], f"{r['rank']}. {r['cause']} ({r['dalys_millions']:.1f})",
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8)

ax3.set_xlim(-0.45,1.45)
ax3.set_ylim(10.8,0.6)
ax3.set_xticks([x_left,x_right])
ax3.set_xticklabels(['1990 Rank','2024 Rank'])
ax3.set_yticks(range(1,11))
ax3.set_ylabel('Rank (1 = highest DALY burden)')
ax3.set_title('Top-10 DALY Cause Rank Changes, 1990 → 2024 (values in millions)')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.15, linestyle='--')

# Unified legend
legend_elements=[Patch(facecolor=colors[k], label=k) for k in ['Communicable','NCD','Injury']]
fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper center', ncol=3, frameon=False, title='Disease category')

fig.suptitle('Global Disease Burden Transition (DALYs), 1990 vs 2024', fontsize=17, weight='bold', y=0.98)
fig.text(0.5,0.015,
         'Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json | DALY = disability-adjusted life years; values shown in millions or % share as labeled.',
         ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#444444')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0.02,0.04,0.98,0.94])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200)
print('saved /app/output/result.png')
PY
